up: Retrieve compounds with IC50 activity (standard_type = 'IC50', standard_units = 'nM') against the human high-affinity nerve growth factor receptor (target CHEMBL2815). Return the compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, assay description, target name, organism, and the publication's PubMed ID or DOI. Filter activities by standard_type = 'IC50' and standard_units = 'nM'. Filter targets by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2815'. For the publication identifier, prefer PubMed ID if available, otherwise use DOI. Return distinct rows for each qualifying compound.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    ass.description AS assay_description,
    td.pref_name AS target_name,
    td.organism,
    COALESCE(docs.pubmed_id, docs.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs ON a.doc_id = docs.doc_id
WHERE
    a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
    AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2815'
